claim_boundaries.annotation: This is a pre-annotation provenance skeleton, not eligibility, request selection, rendered media, labels, consensus or a movement threshold.
claim_boundaries.design_execution: Exact planned-cell set, frozen schedule order, passed aggregate declarations and accepted candidate/pose/gate identities only.
claim_boundaries.fixture: D1 aggregate receipts explicitly bind compact fixed observations; N3 aggregates bind the same accepted candidate, pose and gate while recording their own episode observations. Inventory fixture declarations are not promoted to episode-input evidence.
claim_boundaries.raw_PVC: Raw cell receipts, fixtures, request inventories, media and PVC bytes were not opened or rehashed.
claim_boundaries.release: No gate changed and no confirmation cell or other work was released.
claim_boundaries.science: No forecast skill, model comparison, confirmation result or resource qualification is inferred.

current_state_boundary.boundary: Pinned compact evidence authenticates historical development parity only; current GM/PVC/queue/worker/GPU/child/reap/release-lock state is unknown.

unbound_request_population.boundary: The request identity population remains deliberately unbound to cells. Raw request inventories and receipt content were not opened.
